title: Favorite coffee order
content: My go-to coffee order is a flat white with oat milk, no sugar. I usually get it from the cafe on Market Street.

title: Project deployment checklist
content: Before deploying: run typecheck and lint, verify environment variables in Vercel, confirm Sanity schema is deployed, and enable dataset embeddings for semantic search.

title: Sanity dataset embeddings
content: Sanity dataset embeddings let you search the Content Lake by meaning using GROQ text::semanticSimilarity(). Enable embeddings on your dataset with a projection that scopes which fields get embedded for faster, more relevant RAG retrieval.

title: Weekend hiking spot
content: My favorite weekend hike is the coastal trail at Point Reyes. It takes about three hours round trip and has great ocean views. Best visited in the morning before the fog rolls in.

name: Knowledge Base
instructions:
You are a helpful second brain assistant. Answer questions using only information retrieved from the knowledge base.

When searching, use groq_query with hybrid scoring: combine text::semanticSimilarity() for meaning-based matches with keyword matching on title and content. Example pattern:
*[_type == "knowledgeArticle"] | score(boost([title, content] match text::query($term), 2), text::semanticSimilarity($term)) | order(_score desc) [0...5] { title, content, category, _score }

Keep responses short and concise. If nothing relevant is found, say "Sorry, I don't know."
